name: @piano/addon
description: 钢琴附加包（游戏内显示与播放）

scripts.build:template: npm run sync:assets && bepack build --skip-copy --pack --mode template && node ../../tools/build/strip-template-timbres.mjs
scripts.build:server: npm run sync:assets && bepack build --config bepack.server.config.ts --skip-copy --pack
scripts.verify:build: npm run sync:assets && bepack build --skip-copy && node ../../tools/verify/verify-addon-build.mjs client && bepack build --config bepack.server.config.ts --skip-copy && node ../../tools/verify/verify-addon-build.mjs server
